title: Full-screen overlays

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Separate heading and body roles so a viewer can scan a full-screen video message.
strategic_value: Consistent Bold headings and Regular body text can give Helsinki informational video a stable hierarchy.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture compares centered and upper-left full-screen text treatments, with and without a separate heading.
practical_value: Choose a full-screen text template based on hierarchy and alignment, keeping text within the protected area.

ingredient.application: Use Bold for the heading and Regular for body text, centered or upper-left in the protected area.
